_comment: Durable feed-rename ledger: FPL renames a player when a namesake arrives (web_name is not stable across a season). Frozen snapshots keep the name the feed used THAT week, so graders, exporters and live joins resolve old names through this map. Squad-state 'aliases' are per-squad and get wiped by wildcard resets — this file is the season-long record. core/fpl_diff detects renames; append them here when the churn report shows one.
